title: Kazakh deputies approve draft law ratifying the UN Convention against Cybercrime
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day (25 November), which reports the vote.
geo_basis: national legislature; city not stated in the page
summary: Kazinform reports that deputies of the Kazakh Qurultay approved, in two readings, a draft law ratifying the UN Convention against Cybercrime. The explanatory note, as reported, says the convention would strengthen measures against cybercrime and international cooperation, and provide technical assistance.
plain: Kazakhstan's parliament deputies have approved a draft law to ratify the UN Convention against Cybercrime, Kazinform reports.
exec: Kazakhstan is moving to ratify the UN cybercrime treaty, which Kazinform says would create a legal framework for exchanging electronic evidence.

validation.note: One publisher (Kazinform, state news agency) read; the parliament's own page was not read.
